what: Cover scene of the Workshop 3 progress deck (https://claude.ai/artifact/8o2ZFe8tHr5Z4yojpAoNvC), 22 Nov 2026. New scene type: a roadside milestone; Zholdas plants a small red pennant and looks at the viewer (the cover).

cover-milestone.jpg.scene: a roadside milestone on an Alpine hillside; Zholdas plants a red pennant and looks at the viewer

letters-postbox.jpg.scene: a red postbox by a country road; Zholdas slips a stack of letters into it, looking at the slot

paint-lane-corner.webp.scene: a road growing from the right and bottom edges, transparent elsewhere, the left edge feathered; Zholdas paints a fresh white lane line (work in progress)

before-after-band.jpg.scene: one continuous valley, 21:9: on the left Zholdas squints into fog with an old phone; on the right, in sun, Zholdas reads a radar screen; train and ferry in view. Neither looks at the viewer.

empty-mailbox.jpg.scene: the gate of a trucking yard; Zholdas peers into an empty mailbox, scratching his cap, his own letters at his feet

farewell-buffer-stop.jpg.scene: the end of a railway siding at dusk: Zholdas sits on a red buffer stop with a thermos cup and lifts his cap to the viewer (the finale, so he may look at the camera); resting freight wagons, a small truck by a warehouse, the Alps behind. New scene type: a buffer stop, the end of the line.
